description: Eight independent square seamless pixel art texture materials for an HD-2D low-poly 3D tactical arena. Perfect flat orthographic TOP DOWN surface fills square fully; no side faces, no fixed cast shadows, no baked directional lighting, no objects, opaque. Crisp pixels, restrained limited palette. 1). dark charcoal basalt ground with tiny dull rust-red ash flecks, no glowing whole floor. 2). similar basalt ground slightly warmer charcoal. 3). obsidian central mosaic with circular muted ember-orange rune. 4). stratified dark basalt cliff with sparse orange fissures. 5). carbonized black tree bark with sparse ember-red grain. 6). charcoal dried foliage and grey ash with sparse dull ember flecks. 7). charred timber planks. 8). rough basalt rock with restrained thin orange fissures.
